title: Effect of Local Administration of Morphine for Analgesia After Iliac Bone Graft Harvest
brief_summary: The goal of the current study was to evaluate the analgesic efficacy of low-dose morphine administered to the site of bone graft harvesting in patients undergoing orthopedic surgery. In addition to short-term analgesic effects, the incidence of chronic donor site pain was evaluated 1,3,6 m after surgery.
raw_criteria:
Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients on opioids
* Neuropathic disease
